question: Estimate the number of toilets/public sanitation units in Mumbai (community + public + commercial).
idealClarificationQuestions: Public + community toilets (shared) + paid toilets in stations + mall washrooms? Yes — all non-private.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Slum population × community toilet seats + commercial spaces × washroom counts.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Actual operational seats (Sulabh + BMC + private): ~1.2-1.5 lakh seats (chronic shortage).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Plus public toilets at railway stations, malls, offices: ~5,000-7,000 facilities.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Total non-private sanitation facilities: ~15,000-20,000 in Greater Mumbai.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Slum community toilets at recommended ratio (1 seat per 35 users)
Plus public toilets at railway stations, malls, offices

calculationFlow: Slum community toilets at recommended ratio (1 seat per 35 users): 9M / 35 = ~2.5 lakh seats.
Actual operational seats (Sulabh + BMC + private): ~1.2-1.5 lakh seats (chronic shortage).

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Total non-private sanitation facilities: ~15,000-20,000 in Greater Mumbai.
